Title: Bing Search APIs will transition from Azure Cognitive Services to Azure Marketplace on 31 October 2023

Body.Content:
Bing Search APIs will transition from Azure Cognitive Services to Azure Marketplace on 31 October 2023.  

 How does this affect me? 

The existing instances of the following Bing Search APIs under Azure Cognitive Services will no longer be supported after 31 October 2023. You can continue to create new instances of Bing Search APIs under the Azure Marketplace.  

  • Bing Auto Suggest  
  • Bing Custom Search  
  • Bing Entity Search  
  • Bing Spell Check  
  • Bing Web Search  

What actions should I take? 

Start using the Azure Marketplace to create new instances of Bing Search APIs. Learn more here.  

 If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A.  If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a  support request:
